article.story: EDINBURG, Texas -- — Dylan Hayman scored 19 points to help Incarnate Word defeat UT Rio Grande Valley 66-60 on Monday night. Hayman also grabbed nine rebounds for the Cardinals (13-14, 6-10 Southland Conference). Jalin Anderson added 17 points and five assists. Jordan Pyke shot 5 of 11 from the field and 6 of 6 from the free-throw line to finish with 16 points. Howard Fleming Jr. led the Vaqueros (14-13, 6-10) with 15 points. Trey Miller had 14 points and Dekedran Thorn pitched in with 13 points and three steals. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
